text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Making the wheels of destiny grind and 
creak, charge headlong into the Takarazuka 
Kinen! There was never an end of the line 
to begin with!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The battlefield is graced by countless 
superstars. Those with different 
perspectives, those worthy of the name of 
miracles.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And to you, the Jet-Black Emperor! I will 
destroy and rebuild the destiny you bring 
about! All so I can forge ahead into the 
future!
